title: Indian Geography Challenge
description: Explore the physical features of the Indian subcontinent: Himalayan peaks, river basins, plateaus, and passes.
seoTitle: Indian Geography Quiz – Mountains, Rivers & States | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: Test your knowledge of Indian geography with 10 questions on the Ganges, Western Ghats, Thar Desert, and highest peaks.

questions.question: What is the highest mountain peak situated entirely within undisputed Indian territory?
questions.explanation: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) lies on the Sikkim-Nepal border, while Nanda Devi (7,816 m) is the highest peak located entirely within India.

questions.question: Which major river is known as the 'Dakshin Ganga' (Ganges of the South)?
questions.explanation: Godavari is often called 'Dakshin Ganga' or 'Vridha Ganga' due to its large basin size and religious significance across peninsular India.

questions.question: Which mountain range runs parallel to the western coast of peninsular India and is a recognized UNESCO World Heritage biodiversity hotspot?
questions.explanation: The Western Ghats (Sahyadri) run 1,600 km parallel to the western coast and host exceptional biological diversity.

questions.question: What is the name of the salt desert situated in the Kutch district of Gujarat?
questions.explanation: The Great Rann of Kutch is a seasonal salt marsh located in the Thar Desert biogeographic zone of Gujarat.

questions.question: Which Indian river originates near Lake Manasarovar in Tibet, where it is known as the Yarlung Tsangpo?
questions.explanation: The Brahmaputra originates in southwestern Tibet as the Yarlung Tsangpo before flowing into Arunachal Pradesh and Assam.

questions.question: Which is the smallest Indian state by land area?
questions.explanation: Goa covers an area of roughly 3,702 square kilometers, making it India's smallest state by land area.

questions.question: What strait separates India from the island nation of Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait lies between Tamil Nadu, India, and the Jaffna District of Sri Lanka.

questions.question: Which Indian state shares borders with three neighboring foreign countries: China, Nepal, and Bhutan?
questions.explanation: Sikkim is bordered by Nepal in the west, China's Tibet Autonomous Region in the north and northeast, and Bhutan in the east.

questions.question: What is the oldest fold mountain system in India?
questions.explanation: The Aravalli Range is one of the oldest geological fold mountain systems in the world, dating to the Proterozoic eon.

questions.question: The southernmost point of Indian territory, located in the Nicobar Islands, is known as what?
questions.explanation: Indira Point on Great Nicobar Island is the southernmost point of the Republic of India (6°45'10″ N latitude).
